@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def dip_by_carrier_type(alt, mo, pl, shipments):
    _year = pl.col('ship_date').dt.year()
    _q2 = (
        shipments.filter(pl.col('ship_date').dt.quarter().eq(2))
        .group_by('carrier_type')
        .agg(
            q2_2023=_year.eq(2023).sum().cast(pl.Int64),
            q2_2024=_year.eq(2024).sum().cast(pl.Int64),
        )
        .with_columns(drop=pl.col('q2_2023').sub(pl.col('q2_2024')))
        .with_columns(pct_drop=pl.col('drop').truediv(pl.col('q2_2023')))
        .sort('carrier_type')
        .collect()
    )
    _overall = _q2.select(
        pct_drop=pl.col('drop').sum().truediv(pl.col('q2_2023').sum())
    )
    _bars = (
        alt.Chart(_q2)
        .mark_bar()
        .encode(
            x=alt.X('carrier_type:N', title='Carrier type'),
            y=alt.Y('pct_drop:Q', title='Q2 drop, 2023 to 2024', axis=alt.Axis(format='%')),
            tooltip=['carrier_type', 'q2_2023', 'q2_2024', 'drop', alt.Tooltip('pct_drop:Q', format='.1%')],
        )
    )
    _rule = (
        alt.Chart(_overall)
        .mark_rule(strokeDash=[4, 4], color='black')
        .encode(y='pct_drop:Q')
    )
    mo.ui.altair_chart(_bars + _rule)
    return
